basis: Online guest text about pizza and on-site dining; delivery logistics excluded. Ratings alone do not substitute for sub-scores. Scale: each criterion 0–5, weighted to 100 by (35,25,15,15,10)/5. FuPi or AVPN association status does not add points.

venues.name: Elefántos Étterem és Pizzéria / All’Elefante
venues.rationale: 2025 on-site guest reports praise wood-fired Neapolitan pizza and service, but 2026 first-hand reports cite a salty pizza, slow service and a serious billing mistake. Earlier positive reviews and a pleasant location still count. Association membership has no scoring bonus.

venues.name: Zsiráf Buda
venues.rationale: Recent pizza-specific guest text praises the flavor and on-site atmosphere, but several separate guests report undercooked or burned dough or weak toppings. Delivery time and packaging complaints were excluded; kitchen quality comments on pizza were retained. On-site guest feedback supports service and atmosphere.

venues.name: Pizza ’O Sole Mio Buda
venues.rationale: The aggregate Google and Foodora ratings are strong, but the accessible on-site TripAdvisor record has one pickup review and the indexed Google snippets contain mostly stars or generic food/service scores. The five separate pizza and on-site quality criteria cannot yet be justified without guessing.

venues.name: Pizza ’O Sole Mio Göd
venues.rationale: The Google aggregate is strong but indexed recent on-site comments mostly provide category ratings without explaining pizza dough, taste or consistency. The delivery menu and general business summary do not prove all five criteria.
